principles: A fix at one call site is not a fix to the class: 6c98916 (09-22) left ~9.8k invalid-URL failures until 5ca51be (09-28) (live-activities.md §1 endpoint-routing)
Infrastructure failures graded as capability failures poison posteriors; attribute failure reasons before updating beta (§1 endpoint-routing)
A capped trace store dominated by telemetry is a learning substrate only ~5 days deep (§1 trace-store-db)
Minting without automatic retirement accumulates 48% never-run arms; minting is cheap only if retirement is automatic (§1 bloat)
A selection that is not executed and graded never pays down optimism: 60% of picks went to n≤2 arms (§1 selection-learning)
Posterior fields must have one writer and one reader; the activity-row columns are write-dead and vpm has divergent writers (§1 write-read-mismatch)
The learned pathway outperforms fresh derivation 10x (30.8% vs 3.0%); the floor tiers are where the reach contract fails (§1 goal-walk-floor)
Satisfiers and code paths that do real work (24% of executions) sit outside the activity pool, so they are invisible to selection and retirement (law 2) (§2)
